question: What percentage of shareholder approval is needed to force all shareholders into a company sale?
ground_truth_answer: Shareholders holding at least 75% of outstanding shares must approve the sale to trigger the drag-along right, at which point all shareholders must participate on the same terms.

expected_citations.span_hint: If Shareholders holding at least 75% of outstanding shares approve a sale of the Company, all Shareholders must participate in the sale on the same terms.
